config.gain_method: decouple.calibration.fit_gain on all rotenoid compound abundances (present>0)

truth_scoring.named: nominated candidate == truth driver (two-driver truth: always wrong)
truth_scoring.developable: named AND not the cytotoxicity driver (half the episodes make A cytotoxic)

results.uncertainty: Benchmark responses are simulated on real measured LC-MS abundances and real co-occurrence; the chemistry is real, the response is not. Intervals are pair-clustered over 238 compound pairs, not over episodes.
results.acquisition_objective: Expected gain in threshold-aware nomination utility; unitless.

indistinguishable_diagnostic.label: Episodes where no available extract separates the pair
indistinguishable_diagnostic.note: Abstentions under the set-valued rule; the cytotoxic verdict is an answer, not a decline.
